title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 — Prefill and Decode Capacity
description: Qwen3.8 Flash Next inference capacity on the Dell PowerEdge XE7740 using independently optimized Decode and uncached Prefill deployments with full telemetry.

deployment.summary: 4 independent TP2 replicas behind HAProxy leastconn; profile-specific optimized deployments

host_fabric.link_idle: PCIe Gen1 x16 due to power management
host_fabric.link_under_load: PCIe Gen5 x16 on all eight GPUs

upi.reason: UPI PMUs exist but expose no named sysfs events; pinned Intel PCM detected four UPI ports/socket but could not acquire occupied/restricted PMUs. Destructive PCM -r was not used.

limitations: DCGM PCIe rates are GPU endpoint rates, not internal switch counters.
CUDA sample P2P output warns it is not a formal performance benchmark.
NCCL uses the pinned serving-image NCCL version and NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1.

notes: These measurements were launched without the required pre-run human freeze contract and are classified as qualification evidence, not an approved formal campaign.
Prefill uses --disable-radix-cache and 4096 input / 8 output tokens. Decode uses 8 input / 512 output tokens.
The separate 167,808 input tok/s cache-enabled observation is excluded from the selected uncached Prefill series.
Balanced 512/512 qualification evidence is preserved outside the reader-facing report because the approved report contract permits only Prefill and Decode throughput concepts.
Raw artifacts remain authoritative; no report checksums were generated.
HAProxy frontend/backend traffic and SGLang scheduler/cache metrics are normalized from exact-window raw Prometheus snapshots.
Per-run PCIe endpoint RX/TX and replay deltas were retrospectively exported from retained VictoriaMetrics samples over each exact benchmark window.
Process-memory PSS/RSS is available for these new high-concurrency Prefill points; it remains unavailable for older runs whose collector excluded SGLang.
Decode and uncached Prefill each have three repetitions at every selected C1/C32/C64/C96/C128/C160/C192/C224 point.
High-concurrency Prefill C128/C160/C192/C224 was repeated three times with complete GPU, host, HAProxy, backend, link-state, and PCIe telemetry.

container.base_image: lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38flashnext (OCI index digest sha256:12d3392bdc8be8d35e9a95f191df6aef99c5114bdbefd41bfdc7e760e6d25ec1); SGLang base commit d91c3682b0b429e4c70df63cd57f819588ce29b0
container.engine: SGLang (lmsysorg base) with the TRT-LLM QSA decode path, modelopt_fp4 quantization, flashinfer_cutlass FP4 GEMM, NEXTN speculative decoding (3 steps / topk 1 / 4 draft tokens)
container.caveats: The published base image lacks SM120 support in the TRT-LLM QSA decode path; the operator widened the architecture guard from SM100-only to SM100-or-SM120 in a local source edit and committed the image. The build recipe was not recorded — pulling the base tag alone will NOT reproduce these measurements. The change is described in journal/2026-09-01-qwen38-flash-next-aggressive-tuning.md and is re-derivable by inspecting the image on xe7740-04, but it is not reproducible from this repository.

reproducibility.topology: 4 independent TP2 replicas (GPU pairs [0,1] [2,3] [4,5] [6,7]), ports 8101-8104, HAProxy 3.2-alpine leastconn frontend 127.0.0.1:8000 with a stats/metrics endpoint on 8404

launch.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# In-container server command for the decode-optimized profile.
#
# Recovered verbatim from the campaign's generated scripts at
#   .../formal-completion-v2/deployments/decode/{a,b,c,d}/launch.sh
# All four replicas were byte-identical apart from --port, so the port is the
# only value parameterised here.
#
# Runs inside local/qwen38-flash-next-sm120:operator-patched; see
# ../deployment.yaml for the container identity and its required SM120 patch.
set -euo pipefail
PORT="${PORT:?set PORT to the replica port, 8101 to 8104}"

exec python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
 --model-path /model --served-model-name qwen38-flash-next-nvfp4 \
 --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --tp 2 --trust-remote-code \
 --mem-fraction-static 0.95 --context-length 262144 \
 --max-running-requests 48 --max-prefill-tokens 32768 \
 --quantization modelopt_fp4 --fp4-gemm-backend flashinfer_cutlass \
 --page-size 64 --chunked-prefill-size 4096 \
 --no-ple-offload-embedding \
 --linear-attn-prefill-backend triton --linear-attn-decode-backend flashinfer \
 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer \
 --mamba-track-interval 64 --max-mamba-cache-size 240 \
 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 48 \
 --speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-num-steps 3 \
 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 \
 --reasoning-parser auto --tool-call-parser auto --enable-metrics

launch.profile: prefill (workload: 4096 input / 8 output tokens, radix cache disabled for the prefill series)
launch.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# In-container server command for the prefill-optimized-uncached profile.
#
# Recovered verbatim from the campaign's generated scripts at
#   .../formal-completion-v2/deployments/prefill/{a,b,c,d}/launch.sh
# All four replicas were byte-identical apart from --port.
#
# Differs from the decode profile in six flags: narrower admission and decode
# graph, larger prefill and chunk sizes, half the Mamba cache, no speculative
# decoding, and radix cache disabled so prefill is measured uncached.
set -euo pipefail
PORT="${PORT:?set PORT to the replica port, 8101 to 8104}"

exec python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
 --model-path /model --served-model-name qwen38-flash-next-nvfp4 \
 --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --tp 2 --trust-remote-code \
 --mem-fraction-static 0.95 --context-length 262144 \
 --max-running-requests 24 --max-prefill-tokens 65536 \
 --quantization modelopt_fp4 --fp4-gemm-backend flashinfer_cutlass \
 --page-size 64 --chunked-prefill-size 16384 \
 --no-ple-offload-embedding \
 --linear-attn-prefill-backend triton --linear-attn-decode-backend flashinfer \
 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer \
 --mamba-track-interval 64 --max-mamba-cache-size 120 \
 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 24 \
 --disable-radix-cache \
 --reasoning-parser auto --tool-call-parser auto --enable-metrics

client.version: not recorded in the legacy run manifests (recorded gap)
client.workloads: Decode 8-in/512-out on the decode-optimized profile; Prefill 4096-in/8-out on the prefill profile. One server configuration per measured series.

procedure.action: Published SGLang image found lacking SM120 in the TRT-LLM QSA decode path
procedure.detail: The decode path's architecture guard accepted SM100 only. The operator widened the guard to SM100-or-SM120 in a local source edit and committed the image as local/qwen38-flash-next-sm120:operator-patched; the build recipe was not recorded, which is why this page marks the runtime as not reproducible from this repository alone.

procedure.action: Whole-machine tuning raster to find the highest stable serving throughput
procedure.detail: Separate maximum-throughput configurations settled for decode (max_running_requests 48, chunked prefill 4096, mamba cache 240, cuda-graph 48) and prefill (max_running_requests 24, max_prefill_tokens 65536, chunked prefill 16384, mamba cache 120, cuda-graph 24); journal/2026-09-01-qwen38-flash-next-aggressive-tuning.md.

procedure.action: 4 independent TP2 replicas behind HAProxy leastconn
procedure.detail: Four GPU pairs, ports 8101-8104, HAProxy 3.2-alpine leastconn on 127.0.0.1:8000; the intended production topology, qualified before the campaign.

procedure.action: Campaign launched without the required pre-run human freeze contract
procedure.detail: These measurements are classified as qualification evidence, not an approved formal campaign, and the publication says so explicitly — the freeze-contract gate cannot be retrofitted.
